name: Gravity Putt
shortDescription: Golf across a gravity field: one drag to launch, planets bend the shot.
description: Mini-golf in a planetary system. Drag back from the ball to aim with a live trajectory preview, release to launch, and let the planets' gravity bend your line around hazards and into the glowing cup. Black holes swallow the ball and cost a stroke, repulsors shove it away, wormholes teleport it across the field. Twelve hand-built holes across three chapters, rated by strokes against par.
